label: agent loop • select an opaque-name worker by its description
query: Delegate a separate arithmetic check of 17 plus 25 to one appropriate available worker, then report its result. Address the chosen worker by its UUID.
notes: Names are deliberately opaque. The selected worker must follow the model-visible description; target identity and successful continuation are scored deterministically. Native model defaults remain unchanged.

spawnAgents.description: Reviews code changes for bugs. Use for software review tasks.
spawnAgents.systemPrompt: Review supplied code for bugs. Be concise.
